getter.requires: Non-null result pointer and successful GetFrustum, positive near distance and positive view radius.
getter.resultInitialization: Resets output lens to0 before reading frustum.
getter.viewRadius: Use halfWidth when halfWidth<=halfHeight OR IsTwoPointPerspectiveProjection(); otherwise halfHeight.
getter.projectionGate: No explicit perspective-only gate in this getter.

setter.requires: ON_IsValid(lens) and lens>0, successful GetFrustum, positive near distance and view radius.
setter.deadband: abs(scale-1)<1e-6 returns true without calling SetFrustum; equality is not included.
setter.updates: Multiply left/right/bottom/top by scale, preserve near/far, return native SetFrustum result.

setCameraAngle.inputMeaning: Smallest half-angle, not vertical or diagonal FOV.
setCameraAngle.limits: Uses native GetFrustum/GetFrustumAspect/SetFrustum and ON_PI/ON_SQRT_EPSILON bounds.

derivedSymmetricOrdinaryPerspective.scope: Inference for symmetric ordinary perspective with a successful lens update; not a Rhino5 runtime measurement or general asymmetric/two-point framing guarantee.

currentPortGap: LegacyCameraPreset preserves50mm request; CadViewportCamera.Fit still intentionally uses a generic PI/4 vertical test camera. No original lens/projection equivalence is claimed.
nextRequired: Map exact GetFrustum/SetFrustum/GetFrustumAspect validation and ON_IsValid/sentinel behavior
Compile published camera methods and independent matrix checks for symmetric/asymmetric/parallel/two-point/deadband/failure cases
Preserve original pose/up/construction plane and visible-design zoom semantics when applying projection
Actual Metal preset frames on iPad/iPhone; original-PC/physical-device visual/persistence acceptance
limits: Published openNURBS6 revision matches existing independent reference pin, not proof of private Rhino5 viewport implementation. No native archive fingerprint or rendering behavior changed.
